entities.summary: Slovenia is a sovereign nation in Southern Europe, Europe. Its capital is Ljubljana. Official languages include Slovenian. Government: Unitary parliamentary republic. Population: approximately 2.1 million. Area: 20,273 km². Comprehensive index for Slovenia covering Celtic/Illyrian roots, Roman Pannonia/Noricum, Slavic settlement (6th century), Carantania (first Slavic state 7th century), Frankish conquest, Habsburg rule (1335-1918, 600 years), Kingdom of Serbs/Croats/Slovenes 1918, Yugoslavia, WWII (Axis occupation, Partisans), communist Yugoslavia (Tito), democratization 1980s, Ten-Day War 1991 (independence from Yugoslavia, shortest war), EU/NATO 2004, Euro 2007, Schengen 2007.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Slovenia's complex history has shaped its unique cultural identity, with significant influences from Celtic/Illyrian roots, Roman Pannonia/Noricum, and Slavic settlement. Its independence in 1991 marked a new era for the country.
